name: The Small Space Edit
seoTitle: The Small Space Edit — Small Space Organization & Renter-Friendly Storage Ideas
tagline: Practical organization ideas for small apartments and renters.
description: Practical, renter-friendly storage and organization ideas for small apartments: tiny kitchens, no-drill bathrooms, small closets and space-saving finds.
author: The Small Space Edit

hero.lead: Thoughtful storage ideas, practical home finds, and renter-friendly inspiration to help you make the most of every inch.
hero.imageAlt: A bright, organized small apartment living room with a storage ottoman, floating shelves and a slim rolling cart

categories.title: Small Kitchen
categories.description: A tiny kitchen can work as hard as a big one when every cabinet, wall and gap has a job. These guides cover cabinet shelf risers, under-sink organizers, wall rails and slim rolling carts, with honest advice on measuring and choosing renter-friendly organizers that make cooking in a small apartment kitchen easier and calmer.
categories.imageAlt: Small kitchen with a sage green rolling cart, glass canisters, a magnetic knife strip and a wall utensil rail

categories.title: Bathroom Storage
categories.description: Apartment bathrooms rarely come with enough storage, and most leases rule out drilling into tile. Our bathroom guides focus on no-drill solutions such as over-the-toilet shelves, tension pole caddies, over-the-door hooks and vanity organizers, plus installation tips that protect your walls and your security deposit.
categories.imageAlt: Narrow bathroom with a wooden over-the-toilet shelf holding rolled sage towels and woven baskets

categories.title: Closet Organization
categories.description: One small reach-in closet can hold far more than you think. These guides walk through slim hangers, double hang rods, hanging shelves, door storage and vacuum storage bags for off-season clothes, so you can keep everything visible, reachable and out of the chair pile in a small bedroom.
categories.imageAlt: Small reach-in closet with matching hangers, a hanging shelf organizer, fabric bins and an over-the-door shoe organizer

categories.title: Renter-Friendly
categories.description: No holes, no paint, no problem. Our renter-friendly guides collect damage-free ways to add storage and style to a rental apartment, including adhesive hooks, tension rods, freestanding shelves and plug-in lighting, along with tips for removing everything cleanly when your lease ends.
categories.imageAlt: Rental apartment corner with adhesive wall hooks, a floating shelf, a plug-in wall sconce and a console table with baskets

categories.title: Space-Saving Furniture
categories.description: In a small apartment, every piece of furniture should earn its spot. These guides cover storage ottomans, rolling carts, over-the-toilet units and other multi-purpose pieces, explaining what to measure and which features matter so you can add storage without crowding the room.
categories.imageAlt: Beige storage ottoman with its lid open showing folded blankets beside a cream sofa
